name: CurtainRevealCard
job: A service card whose stage curtains part on hover to reveal price, duration and what is included
visitor_action: hover/focus or tap to open the curtains; tap again closes; Escape also closes
mobile: tap toggles curtains, details stay open once tapped
art_direction: Full-bleed velvet theatre: wine-plum drapes edge to edge, half-drawn by default so the lit stage glows through the gap, brass-trimmed scalloped valance, large draggable brass tassel, footlights
motion: drapes gather with eased overshoot and fold-shade shift, light floods the stage, price and details stagger in, tassel tugs; pulling the tassel down drags the drapes open; reduced-motion: drapes already open at the sides
